summary: 系统综述与荟萃分析汇总随机对照试验，评估AI心电图筛查在常规诊疗中检出低射血分数的实际效果。

abstract: [Annals of noninvasive electrocardiology : the official journal of the International Society for Holter and Noninvasive Electrocardiology, Inc] Left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD) is common and treatable but often undiagnosed, especially in early stages with non-specific symptoms. AI applied to standard ECGs offers low-cost screening for low ejection fraction (EF), yet its real-world impact on diagnosis remains unclear. A systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs assessed AI-ECG screening for low EF in clinical practice. The protocol was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261287652). Databases (PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Central, Google Scholar) were searched from inception to January 18, 2026, for RCTs comparing AI-ECG screening to usual care in adults without known heart failure undergoing routine ECGs. The primary outcome was new low EF (≤ 50%) confirmed by echocardiography. Secondary outcomes included echocardiography referral rates, positive predictive value, and cardiology referral rates. Pooled risk ratios (RR) with 95% CIs were calculated using a random-effects model. Three RCTs were included (two individual and one cluster) with 37,467 participants. After adjusting for clustering, AI-ECG screening significantly improved detection of new low EF diagnoses compared to usual care (RR 1.36, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.64; p = 0.002; I2 = 0%), with a number needed to screen of 204. No significant difference was found in echocardiography referral rates (RR 1.02, 95% CI 0.96 to 1.09; p = 0.55; I2 = 36%). The PPV of the AI tool ranged from approximately 20% to 34% across studies. AI-ECG screening added to routine care improves low EF detection without substantially increasing echocardiography referrals. These findings support AI-ECG for earlier LVSD detection in at-risk populations, though further validation across diverse AI platforms is warranted.
zh_abstract: [Annals of noninvasive electrocardiology : the official journal of the International Society for Holter and Noninvasive Electrocardiology, Inc] 左心室收缩功能障碍（LVSD）常见且可治疗，但常未被诊断，尤其是在症状非特异性的早期阶段。将 AI 应用于标准心电图可为低射血分数（EF）提供低成本筛查，但其对诊断的真实世界影响仍不明确。一项针对随机对照试验（RCTs）的系统综述和荟萃分析评估了临床实践中 AI-ECG 筛查低 EF 的情况。该方案已在 PROSPERO 注册（CRD420261287652）。检索了 PubMed、Scopus、Cochrane Central、Google Scholar 等数据库，检索时间从建库至 2026 年 1 月 18 日，纳入在无已知心力衰竭、接受常规心电图的成人中比较 AI-ECG 筛查与常规照护的 RCTs。主要结局为经超声心动图确认的新发低 EF（≤ 50%）。次要结局包括超声心动图转诊率、阳性预测值和心内科转诊率。使用随机效应模型计算合并风险比（RR）及 95% CI。共纳入 3 项 RCTs（两项个体随机和一项整群随机），包含 37,467 名参与者。在对整群效应进行调整后，与常规照护相比，AI-ECG 筛查显著提高了新发低 EF 诊断的检出（RR 1.36，95% CI 1.12 至 1.64；p = 0.002；I2 = 0%），需筛查人数为 204。超声心动图转诊率无显著差异（RR 1.02，95% CI 0.96 至 1.09；p = 0.55；I2 = 36%）。各研究中 AI 工具的 PPV 约为 20% 至 34%。在常规照护基础上增加 AI-ECG 筛查可改善低 EF 检出，而未实质性增加超声心动图转诊。这些发现支持在高危人群中用 AI-ECG 更早检出 LVSD，不过仍需在不同 AI 平台之间进一步验证。

abstract: [Current opinion in immunology] The diagnosis of axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) remains challenging and is frequently delayed. Imaging is central to diagnosis, but relevant inflammatory and structural abnormalities may be subtle, heterogeneous, or overlap with findings related to mechanical stress, anatomical variation, and degeneration. Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning, is therefore being investigated to support image interpretation, lesion detection, quantification, and standardized assessment. We synthesize evidence from 12 studies applying convolutional neural networks and related architectures to magnetic resonance imaging and radiographs, automate imaging scores, and combine imaging-derived information with clinical variables. Several models achieved performance comparable to experienced human readers, including during external validation. However, performance may decline in heterogeneous real-world populations for study-specific reasons not explained solely by scanner or protocol differences. No AI tool currently has regulatory clearance for autonomous use in axSpA, and applications remain largely confined to research and clinical trials.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in immunology] 中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）的诊断仍然具有挑战性，并且常常被延迟。影像学是诊断的核心，但相关的炎症性和结构性异常可能较轻微、异质性大，或与机械应力、解剖变异和退变相关表现重叠。因此，人工智能（AI），尤其是深度学习，正被研究用于支持图像解读、病灶检测、定量和标准化评估。我们综合了12项研究的证据，这些研究将卷积神经网络及相关架构应用于磁共振成像和X线平片，实现影像评分自动化，并将影像衍生信息与临床变量相结合。若干模型达到了与有经验的人类阅片者相当的性能，包括在外部验证期间。然而，在异质性真实世界人群中，由于研究特异性原因（不能仅用扫描仪或方案差异解释），性能可能下降。目前尚无AI工具获得监管许可用于axSpA的自主使用，应用仍主要局限于研究和临床试验。

abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] To develop a deep learning (DL) based probabilistic 3D deformable image registration framework for uncertainty-aware dose accumulation in magnetic resonance imaging-guided radiotherapy (MRgRT) of lung cancer. Approach: We propose TransMorph-prob (TM-prob), a variational Bayesian model that predicts the voxel-wise mean and variance of dense displacement fields (DDFs). Two TM-prob models were trained on an internal CT dataset (725 patients) and a low-field MR-linac dataset (102 patients), and benchmarked against Monte Carlo dropout TransMorph (TM-MCD) and DIRUncertainty with B-spline initialization (ASDIR) on the DIRLAB 4DCT dataset (10 patients, 3000 landmarks), and an annotated MR-linac dataset (16 patients, 107 image pairs, 227 landmarks) with target and seven organ-at-risk (OAR) contours. Both datasets contained an additional 1239/13,289 algorithm-generated landmarks. Performance was evaluated using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), landmark- and voxel-wise expected calibration errors (LECE/ECE), and dose distributions derived from 2000 DDF samples per patient. Main results: On the DIRLAB dataset, TM-prob achieved a median TRE of \qty{1.8}{\mm}/\qty{2.8}{\mm} on manual/algorithm-generated landmarks, versus \qty{1.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.4}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{2.1}{\mm}/\qty{3.0}{\mm} for TM-MCD. On the MRI dataset, TM-prob achieved the median TRE of \qty{3.9}{\mm}/\qty{2.6}{\mm} and a mean DSC of 0.87, matching ASDIR (\qty{3.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.7}{\mm}, and DSC of 0.87) while outperforming TM-MCD (\qty{4.4}{\mm}/\qty{2.9}{\mm}, and 0.84). In uncertainty calibration, TM-prob achieved a LECE of \qty{1.74}{\mm}/\qty{0.30}{\mm} on MRI manual/algorithm-generated landmarks versus \qty{2.41}{\mm}/\qty{0.56}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{6.65}{\mm}/\qty{3.92}{\mm} for TM-MCD, and an average contour ECE of 5.8% versus 7.0% and 21.2%. Two patients with indistinct GTV boundaries exhibited substantially wider target D95 distributions, demonstrating that calibrated DDF uncertainty translates into clinically relevant dose-coverage uncertainty. Significance: TM-prob is an end-to-end DL model, achieving fast, well-calibrated, uncertainty-aware registration for lung cancer patients, enabling reliable DDF uncertainty propagation into dose accumulation for clinical decision-making in online adaptive radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: 开发一种基于深度学习（DL）的概率性3D可变形图像配准框架，用于肺癌磁共振成像引导放疗（MRgRT）中考虑不确定性的剂量累积。【方法】我们提出TransMorph-prob（TM-prob），一种变分贝叶斯模型，用于预测稠密位移场（DDF）的体素级均值和方差。两个TM-prob模型分别在内部CT数据集（725例患者）和低场MR-linac数据集（102例患者）上训练，并在DIRLAB 4DCT数据集（10例患者，3000个标志点）和标注的MR-linac数据集（16例患者，107对图像，227个标志点，含靶区和七个危及器官（OAR）轮廓）上与蒙特卡洛dropout TransMorph（TM-MCD）和带B样条初始化的DIRUncertainty（ASDIR）进行基准比较。两个数据集分别额外包含1239个和13,289个算法生成的标志点。性能评估采用靶点配准误差（TRE）、Dice相似系数（DSC）、标志点和体素级期望校准误差（LECE/ECE），以及每位患者2000个DDF样本推导的剂量分布。【结果】在DIRLAB数据集上，TM-prob在手动/算法生成的标志点上达到中位TRE为1.8 mm/2.8 mm，ASDIR为1.3 mm/2.4 mm，TM-MCD为2.1 mm/3.0 mm。在MRI数据集上，TM-prob达到中位TRE 3.9 mm/2.6 mm和平均DSC 0.87，与ASDIR（3.3 mm/2.7 mm，DSC 0.87）相当，同时优于TM-MCD（4.4 mm/2.9 mm，DSC 0.84）。在不确定性校准方面，TM-prob在MRI手动/算法生成标志点上的LECE为1.74 mm/0.30 mm，而ASDIR为2.41 mm/0.56 mm，TM-MCD为6.65 mm/3.92 mm；平均轮廓ECE为5.8%，而ASDIR和TM-MCD分别为7.0%和21.2%。两例GTV边界不清的患者表现出显著更宽的目标D95分布，表明经校准的DDF不确定性可转化为临床相关的剂量覆盖不确定性。【结论】TM-prob是一种端到端DL模型，可为肺癌患者实现快速、良好校准且考虑不确定性的配准，使DDF不确定性能够可靠传播至剂量累积，以支持在线自适应放疗中的临床决策。

abstract: Background. Care management programs increasingly rely on prediction algorithms to decide which patients receive limited healthcare resources. Because these algorithms are typically trained to predict future healthcare utilization or cost, they may systematically underidentify patients whose care-seeking behavior is suppressed by structural barriers. Objective. To evaluate how three modifiable design choices (selection threshold, feature set, and training objective) affect allocation equity in care management targeting. Methods. We constructed an analytical cohort of 201,216 adults from linked electronic health record and participant survey data in the NIH All of Us Research Program (2017-2019). Three prediction models (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) were trained and evaluated under simulation conditions that varied one design choice at a time while holding the others fixed. Equity was assessed using false negative rate (FNR), equal opportunity difference (EOD), and allocation rate conditional on need (an access-independent benchmark based on self-reported general health status). We also applied Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition to identify which predictors contributed most to the Black-White allocation gap. Results. Prior utilization understated self-reported health burden among disadvantaged groups: 33% of Black and 32% of Hispanic participants reported fair or poor health, yet only 22% and 19% were classified as high utilizers. White participants showed the opposite pattern: 25% were classified as high utilizers, while only 19% reported fair or poor general health status. Under baseline design choices, all three models produced similar disparities, with uninsured participants showing the largest gap (EOD: -0.148). Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition identified prior outpatient visits as the dominant contributor to the Black-White gap in predicted allocation, with higher average emergency department utilization among Black participants partially offsetting the effect. Varying the selection threshold had little effect; disparities persisted across all thresholds. Feature set variation produced mixed and group-specific effects; removal of prior outpatient visits achieved near-zero Black-White EOD (0.001, AUC: 0.77), consistent with the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition finding. Training objective variation produced the most substantial and consistent equity effects, with the health status objective achieving near-zero Black-White EOD (0.008, AUC: 0.69) an

title: Single-cell perturbation prediction near experimental reproducibility with GENESIS

abstract: Single-cell perturbation atlases now measure cellular responses across millions of cells, but the number of possible combinations of biological contexts, perturbations, doses and other experimental variables make exhaustive measurements infeasible. Here, we present GENESIS (Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator), a generative framework that predicts single-cell response distributions directly from the covariates defining an experimental condition. GENESIS uses a lightweight neural network trained with the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule for distributions. We introduce an experiment-calibrated evaluation framework in which prediction error is interpreted relative to the reproducibility of repeated measurements of the same condition. Across the Tahoe-100M small-molecule atlas and a large PBMC cytokine atlas, GENESIS significantly outperforms existing generative models and statistical baselines and approaches experimental reproducibility on independently repeated conditions. Importantly, GENESIS remains accurate when trained on only a fraction of the available experimental conditions or cells, and generated profiles recover experimentally observed context-dependent transcriptional programs. At comparable training-cell budgets, GENESIS achieves more accurate predictions when measurements span more experimental conditions rather than profiling fewer conditions more deeply. Together, these findings suggest a complementary strategy for perturbation studies: broader, lower-depth measurements can expand experimental coverage, while GENESIS augments sparsely sampled populations and predicts responses in unmeasured conditions.
zh_abstract: 单细胞扰动图谱如今可在数百万个细胞中测量细胞反应，但生物背景、扰动、剂量及其他实验变量的可能组合数量使穷尽式测量不可行。在此，我们提出GENESIS（Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator，基于生成能量模型的单细胞干预模拟器），这是一个可直接根据定义实验条件的协变量预测单细胞反应分布的生成式框架。GENESIS使用一个轻量级神经网络，并以能量得分（energy score）进行训练，该得分是针对分布的严格适当评分规则。我们引入一个实验校准的评估框架，其中预测误差是相对于同一条件重复测量的可重复性来解释的。在Tahoe-100M小分子图谱和一个大型PBMC细胞因子图谱中，GENESIS显著优于现有生成模型和统计基线，并在独立重复条件上接近实验可重复性。重要的是，仅用可用实验条件或细胞的一部分进行训练时，GENESIS仍保持准确，且生成的图谱可恢复实验观察到的背景依赖性转录程序。在可比的训练细胞预算下，当测量覆盖更多实验条件而不是对更少条件进行更深剖析时，GENESIS可实现更准确的预测。总之，这些发现提示扰动研究的一种互补策略：更广泛、较低深度的测量可扩大实验覆盖范围，而GENESIS可增强稀疏采样的群体并预测未测量条件下的反应。

abstract: RNA foundation models offer a promising route to decoding the relationships between RNA sequence, structure and function, yet how model shapes the acquisition and organization of biological information remains poorly understood. Here we introduce Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA (LIMBER), a hybrid foundation model integrating bidirectional self-attention with selective state-space modeling, pretrained on 40.5 million non-coding RNA sequences. Through task-specific fine-tuning, LIMBER achieves leading performance on secondary-structure prediction and non-coding RNA classification benchmarks, while demonstrating strong transferability to translation-related tasks and RNA--small-molecule interaction prediction. Beyond model development, we establish a unified, task-agnostic framework to systematically evaluate and interpret the biological knowledge intrinsically acquired by RNA foundation models. This framework validates LIMBER's strong capabilities in recovering RNA structures and predicting mutational effects, while uncovering a hierarchical, task-dependent organization of different biological information across model layers. By further systematically training and evaluating a broad panel of model variants spanning model capacity, training duration and dataset size, we uncover distinct scaling behaviors across structural, evolutionary and functional capabilities. Together, these findings establish LIMBER as a versatile RNA foundation model and provide broader insights into how architectural design, internal representations and scaling shape the learning of RNA sequence-structure-function relationships.
zh_abstract: RNA基础模型为解码RNA序列、结构与功能之间的关系提供了一条有前景的途径，但模型如何塑造生物信息的获取和组织仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出LIMBER（Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA，用于RNA的层间交错Mamba双向编码器），这是一个整合双向自注意力与选择性状态空间建模的混合基础模型，在4050万条非编码RNA序列上进行了预训练。通过任务特异性微调，LIMBER在二级结构预测和非编码RNA分类基准上取得领先性能，同时展示出对翻译相关任务和RNA–小分子相互作用预测的强迁移能力。除模型开发外，我们建立了一个统一的、任务无关的框架，以系统评估和解释RNA基础模型内在获得的生物学知识。该框架验证了LIMBER在恢复RNA结构和预测突变效应方面的强能力，同时揭示了不同生物信息在模型各层中呈层级化、任务依赖的组织方式。通过进一步系统训练和评估涵盖模型容量、训练时长和数据集规模的一组广泛模型变体，我们揭示了结构、进化和功能能力方面不同的缩放行为。总之，这些发现确立了LIMBER作为一个多功能RNA基础模型，并为架构设计、内部表示和缩放如何塑造RNA序列-结构-功能关系的学习提供了更广泛的见解。

title: Advances in artificial intelligence for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis of neurological diseases: a systematic literature review.
zh_title: 脑影像AI与神经系统疾病计算机辅助诊断系统综述
summary: 遵循PRISMA 2020的系统综述，评估2020至2026年脑影像AI与计算机辅助诊断的方法、模态、数据集与验证实践。
key_points: 检索8个信息源，初检1078条记录
覆盖方法、影像模态、疾病与诊断任务
重点分析数据集、验证方式与转化局限
reason: 系统综述纳入大量研究，但摘要未显示明确结论或外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] Brain imaging is central to the structural, functional, metabolic, and neurophysiological characterization of neurological disease, yet interpretation remains constrained by heterogeneity in acquisition, annotation, expertise, and clinical context. This systematic literature review evaluates recent artificial intelligence approaches for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis, with emphasis on methods, modalities, neurological diseases, diagnostic tasks, datasets, validation practices, and translational limitations. The review followed PRISMA 2020 and covered peer-reviewed English-language studies published from January 2020 through June 2026. Eight information sources were searched using database-specific terms for artificial intelligence, neuroimaging, neurological disease, and diagnostic analysis. The search identified 1,078 records; 236 duplicates were removed, 842 unique records were screened, 258 full texts were assessed, and 123 studies were included after a record-level eligibility re-audit. Heterogeneous evidence was synthesized narratively and by descriptive mapping rather than meta-analysis. MRI was frequently represented in the included studies and auxiliary mapping data; CT was commonly used in acute stroke and intracranial hemorrhage; PET supported selected molecular and differential-diagnosis studies; fMRI and diffusion imaging were used for network and white-matter analysis; and EEG extended the scope to neurophysiological diagnosis. CNN and three-dimensional networks were commonly reported, while attention, Transformer, graph, self-supervised, generative, multimodal, and foundation-model approaches appeared in selected recent studies. Stroke, dementia, and brain tumors were frequently represented, but heterogeneous populations, outcomes, and incomplete validation extraction precluded ranking diseases, modalities, architectures, or validation strategies. The evidence suggests movement from task-specific pattern recognition toward multimodal and context-rich decision support in selected settings, but it does not establish uniform methodological superiority or clinical maturity. Dependable translation requires patient-level data governance, transparent reporting, uncertainty estimation, independent multicenter testing, prospective workflow evaluation, and clinically meaningful endpoints.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] 脑成像对于神经系统疾病的结构、功能、代谢和神经生理学表征至关重要，但其解读仍受采集、标注、专业知识和临床背景异质性的制约。本系统文献综述评估了近期用于脑成像和计算机辅助诊断的人工智能方法，重点关注方法、模态、神经系统疾病、诊断任务、数据集、验证实践和转化局限性。该综述遵循 PRISMA 2020，覆盖2020年1月至2026年6月发表的同行评议英文研究。使用针对人工智能、神经影像、神经系统疾病和诊断分析的数据库特定检索词检索了八个信息源。检索识别出1,078条记录；去除236条重复记录，筛选842条唯一记录，评估258篇全文，并在记录层面资格复审后纳入123项研究。异质性证据通过叙述性综合和描述性映射而非荟萃分析进行综合。MRI在纳入研究和辅助映射数据中经常出现；CT常用于急性卒中和颅内出血；PET支持部分分子和鉴别诊断研究；fMRI和扩散成像用于网络和白质分析；EEG将范围扩展到神经生理诊断。CNN和三维网络常被报道，而注意力、Transformer、图、自监督、生成、多模态和基础模型方法出现在部分近期研究中。卒中、痴呆和脑肿瘤经常出现，但异质性人群、结局和不完整的验证信息提取妨碍了对疾病、模态、架构或验证策略进行排序。证据表明在特定场景中正从任务特定模式识别转向多模态和上下文丰富的决策支持，但并未确立统一的方法学优越性或临床成熟度。可靠的转化需要患者层面的数据治理、透明报告、不确定性估计、独立多中心测试、前瞻性工作流程评估和有临床意义的终点。

title: Bioactivity foundation model for hit identification and hit-to-lead optimization from sequence data
zh_title: PSICHIC+：基于序列的活性基础模型用于苗头识别
summary: 预印本提出在约8200万条蛋白-配体记录上训练的活性基础模型PSICHIC+，可从序列在毫秒级预测结合亲和力并用于虚拟筛选。
key_points: 基于分布目标建模，兼容异质活性数据
零样本虚拟筛选富集优于回归/分类方法
与主流结构方法竞争力相当，含实验闭环
reason: 大规模训练数据与基线对比充分，但为未经同行评审的预印本
abstract: Learning from large-scale bioactivity archives is complicated by heterogeneous assay readouts and differences in data reliability. Here we show that a model that predicts probability distributions over binding affinities from sequence data opens model training to vast and diverse troves of heterogeneous bioactivity data. We develop PSICHIC+, a bioactivity foundation model trained on approximately 82 million protein-ligand records using a distributional objective that preserves quantitative resolution while incorporating variation in data reliability. Given a protein sequence and ligand SMILES, PSICHIC+ predicts binding affinity in milliseconds. In zero-shot virtual-screening benchmarks without target-specific training data, it improves enrichment over regression- and classification-based approaches and performs competitively with leading structure-based methods. In lab-in-the-loop campaigns, distribution-guided acquisition improves recovery of high-activity compounds under fixed screening budgets. Combining PSICHIC+ with Boltz-2 improves hit-to-lead affinity prediction over Boltz-2 alone, with mean correlation approaching that of FEP+ on the evaluated benchmarks, without requiring high-resolution protein structures. These results support distributional learning as a scalable approach to using heterogeneous bioactivity data for hit identification and hit-to-lead optimization.
zh_abstract: 从大规模生物活性档案中学习，受到异质性检测读数以及数据可靠性差异的困扰。在此我们表明，一种从序列数据预测结合亲和力概率分布的模型，使模型训练能够利用庞大且多样的异质性生物活性数据宝库。我们开发了PSICHIC+，一种生物活性基础模型，使用分布式目标在约8200万条蛋白质-配体记录上训练，该目标在纳入数据可靠性变异的同时保留定量分辨率。给定蛋白质序列和配体SMILES，PSICHIC+可在毫秒级预测结合亲和力。在无靶点特异性训练数据的零样本虚拟筛选基准中，它相比基于回归和分类的方法提高了富集，并与领先的基于结构的方法具有竞争力。在实验室闭环（lab-in-the-loop）活动中，分布引导的采集在固定筛选预算下提高了高活性化合物的回收率。将PSICHIC+与Boltz-2结合，相比单独使用Boltz-2改善了从命中到先导化合物的亲和力预测，在评估基准上的平均相关性接近FEP+，且无需高分辨率蛋白质结构。这些结果支持分布学习作为一种可扩展方法，利用异质性生物活性数据进行命中识别和从命中到先导化合物的优化。

title: Can Personal Requirements Become Supervision for Planning?
zh_title: 把个人临床要求转为监督的膳食规划智能体
summary: 提出Noura，将公开临床指南与个人健康档案转为可执行规范以监督LLM膳食规划，基于NHANES构建评估。
key_points: 13个模型直接生成完整方案通过率不足3%
将指南实例化为可执行个人规范
评估由营养师认可、基于NHANES构建
reason: 新方法+多模型基线对比与专家认可评估，但为预印本且非临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Managing multiple chronic conditions through diet requires satisfying disease- and medication-specific requirements jointly across meals and days while preserving established eating habits. These requirements are public in clinical guidelines and drug labels, yet turning them into a feasible plan for one person remains difficult for language-model agents. In our dietitian-approved weekly planning evaluation built from NHANES, thirteen models, from medically fine-tuned 8B models to GPT-6.1 Sol, pass fewer than 3% of complete plans through direct generation. Explicit rules, higher reasoning effort, or model-directed tools leave GPT-6.1 Sol at no more than 8%. We present Noura, which pairs LLM planning with executable personal specifications instantiated from public clinical guidance and individual health and dietary profiles. During planning, the specification grounds foods, optimizes portions, checks the complete multi-day plan, and guides revision. Our key insight is that a specification that rejects a plan can also determine what to learn from it. Noura turns executed plans and contextually credited revisions into supervision for compact models, recovering targets even from trajectories that never achieve complete success. The same specification supplies supervised targets, preferences, and rewards for post-training. On 4,993 held-out participants, Noura-SFT raises Qwen3-14B's complete-plan pass rate from 24.0% to 72.5% within the same execution loop, cuts rule violations by 97.5% with no observed critical failures, and improves dietary quality. The locally hosted 14B planner incurs fewer rule violations than its GPT-6 Luna teacher. A matched comparison shows that executed targets reduce rule violations by 41% over model-written proposals. Across four Qwen, Phi, and Llama backbones, self-training alone reduces rule violations by 41-61% on a 1,249-person population subset.
zh_abstract: 通过饮食管理多种慢性病，需要在多餐和多日之间共同满足疾病和药物特定要求，同时保持既有饮食习惯。这些要求公开于临床指南和药品标签中，但将其转化为针对单个人的可行计划，对语言模型智能体而言仍然困难。在我们基于 NHANES 构建、经营养师批准的每周计划评估中，十三个模型——从经医学微调的 8B 模型到 GPT-6.1 Sol——通过直接生成得到的完整计划通过率低于 3%。显式规则、更高推理投入或模型引导的工具使 GPT-6.1 Sol 仍不超过 8%。我们提出 Noura，它将 LLM 规划与可执行的个人规范相结合，这些规范由公开临床指南以及个体健康和饮食档案实例化而来。在规划过程中，该规范对食物进行约束、优化份量、检查完整的多日计划并指导修订。我们的关键洞见是，拒绝某个计划的规范也能决定从该计划中学习什么。Noura 将已执行的计划和按情境给予信用的修订转化为紧凑模型的监督信号，甚至能从从未取得完全成功的轨迹中恢复目标。同一规范为后训练提供监督目标、偏好和奖励。在 4,993 名留出参与者上，Noura-SFT 在同一执行循环内将 Qwen3-14B 的完整计划通过率从 24.0% 提高到 72.5%，将规则违规减少 97.5%，且未观察到关键失败，并改善饮食质量。本地托管的 14B 规划器产生的规则违规少于其 GPT-6 Luna 教师模型。一项匹配比较显示，与模型书写的提案相比，执行目标使规则违规减少 41%。在四个 Qwen、Phi 和 Llama 主干模型上，仅自训练就在 1,249 人的人群子集上将规则违规减少 41–61%。

title: BABA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Patient-Advocacy Agents
zh_title: BABA-Bench：长程患者权益代理评测基准
summary: 基于47个真实患者维权案例构建交互环境，评测14个前沿模型在结果与流程合规上的表现。
key_points: 47个去标识化真实病例构建交互世界
逐步核查授权、证据与禁止行为
14个模型共1974次运行，常出现结果正确但路径违规
reason: 预印本新基准，规模有限但设计有新意且公开评测，属值得一看档
abstract: An LLM agent that helps a patient get care must do two things. It must reach the correct outcome, and it must follow the necessary procedure. For example, the agent must get the patient's permission before it shares the patient's records. We introduce BABA-Bench, a benchmark of 47 interactive worlds. We built each world from a de-identified, real patient advocacy case that expert advocates reviewed. In each world, the agent must find hidden information and coordinate insurers, clinics, suppliers, pharmacies, and community organizations. The engine checks each action at the time the agent does it. It checks if the agent has permission, if the agent has evidence for the action, and if the action is prohibited. We evaluated 14 frontier models with three runs on each world, for a total of 1,974 runs. Agents often reached the correct outcome by an invalid route. Of the 921 runs that reached all required outcomes, 254 (28%) did not follow the necessary procedure. Claude Opus 5 reached all required outcomes in 81.6% of its runs, but only 52.5% of its runs passed all checks. When we gave two models a verified route, their pass rates increased from 29.8% to 91.5% and from 44.0% to 97.2%. For these models, the main problem is to find a route, not to execute it.
zh_abstract: 帮助患者获得医疗服务的 LLM 智能体必须做两件事。它必须达到正确的结果，并且必须遵循必要的程序。例如，智能体在共享患者记录之前必须获得患者许可。我们推出 BABA-Bench，一个包含 47 个交互式世界的基准。每个世界都基于经专家倡导者审核的、去标识化的真实患者倡导案例构建。在每个世界中，智能体必须找到隐藏信息，并协调保险公司、诊所、供应商、药房和社区组织。引擎在智能体执行每个动作时进行检查。它检查智能体是否有许可、智能体是否有采取该动作的证据，以及该动作是否被禁止。我们评估了 14 个前沿模型，每个世界运行三次，总计 1,974 次运行。智能体常常通过无效路径达到正确结果。在达到所有必需结果的 921 次运行中，有 254 次（28%）未遵循必要程序。Claude Opus 5 在其 81.6% 的运行中达到所有必需结果，但只有 52.5% 的运行通过所有检查。当我们向两个模型提供一条经核验的路径时，它们的通过率分别从 29.8% 提高到 91.5%，从 44.0% 提高到 97.2%。对这些模型而言，主要问题是找到路径，而不是执行路径。

abstract: [Current drug discovery technologies] Herbal medicines contain complex phytochemicals that offer therapeutic potential, but their long-term adverse effects remain challenging to determine. Traditional herbal medicine preparation methods are often labor-intensive, non-standardized, and face difficulties in identifying active ingredients. By improving medication development, optimization, and discovery procedures, Artificial Intelligence (AI) provides innovative ways to get beyond these restrictions. This systematic review aims to evaluate the role of AI-based software such as LEAFSNAP, Deep- Chem, PlantNet, Autodock, MestReNova, XCMS, ADMETlab, SynergyFinder, KEGG, TCMID, and Reactome in enhancing phytomedicine research by streamlining plant identification, bioactive compound discovery, molecular modeling, and pharmacokinetic profiling, thereby advancing drug discovery and development processes. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis (PRISMA guidelines) to explore the integration of AI-based tools in phytomedicine research and drug discovery. Literature searches were performed in Scopus, PubMed, and Google Scholar databases, focusing on studies published between January 2015 and January 2025. Only English-language articles focusing on AI-based software for drug discovery from plant-derived compounds were reviewed. Studies discussing synthetic drug development were excluded; this, along with non-English language, acted as a literature review limitation. Two reviewers independently screened the titles, abstracts, and full texts of the retrieved articles. Any discrepancies in the screening, study selection, and data extraction processes were resolved through discussion and consensus. Through the effective identification of bioactive chemicals and the simplification of intricate studies, the combination of artificial intelligence and computer tools has completely transformed the process of discovering and developing herbal drugs. Artificial intelligence tools like ADMETlab for pharmacokinetics and toxicity assessments, DeepChem for molecular activity modelling, and AlphaFold for protein structure prediction have greatly improved the search for new herbal drugs. While AutoDock improves molecular docking simulations by automating ligand-receptor binding predictions for bioactive chemicals, LeafSnap and PlantNet make plant identification simpler. Drug development workflows are improved by databases such as KEGG and TC

abstract: [Journal of the American Dental Association (1939)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming policy, research, education, and the practice of dentistry through advances in diagnostics, treatment planning, education, and administration. Despite its clear potential in service delivery and care and transdisciplinary collaboration, the adoption of AI remains fragmented and uneven. The landscape of AI applications in dentistry spans diverse users, tasks, and contexts and presents challenges as well as opportunities for sustainable integration. Moving beyond the typical focus on diagnostic accuracy, the authors investigated dental and medical studies, analyzing how AI can remain sustainable across the profession's fragmented and heterogeneous ecosystem. Some key barriers, such as siloed innovation, ethical uncertainty, and unequal infrastructure, are identified and suggest the need for cohesive engagement across stakeholder groups and collective actions, development of curriculum and ethical frameworks, and regulatory initiatives. The authors outline strategic steps to leverage the profession's diversity as a driver of sustainability.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Dental Association (1939)] 人工智能（AI）正通过诊断、治疗计划、教育和行政管理方面的进步，改变政策、研究、教育和牙科实践。尽管AI在服务提供与照护以及跨学科协作方面具有明显潜力，其采用仍然碎片化且不均衡。牙科AI应用格局涵盖多样用户、任务和情境，并为可持续整合带来挑战与机遇。作者超越通常对诊断准确性的关注，调查了牙科和医学研究，分析AI如何在牙科专业碎片化且异质的生态系统中保持可持续性。识别出一些关键障碍，如孤立式创新、伦理不确定性和基础设施不平等，并提出需要在利益相关群体之间开展凝聚性参与和集体行动、开发课程和伦理框架以及监管举措。作者概述了利用该专业多样性作为可持续性驱动力的战略步骤。

title: Translational maturity of artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography varies across cardiovascular diseases.
zh_title: AI-ECG转化成熟度因心血管病种而异
summary: 该叙述性综述纳入77篇文献，用五项临床导向标准评估AI-ECG在多种心血管疾病中的转化成熟度。
key_points: 检索2022年至2026年7月三大数据库文献
覆盖心律失常、心梗、心衰、瓣膜病等
强调回顾性高判别力不等于临床可行动获益

abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Electrocardiography is a widely available and low-cost cardiovascular test, and artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) can identify latent electrical phenotypes beyond conventional interpretation. However, high retrospective discrimination does not necessarily translate into clinically reliable or actionable benefit. This critical narrative review evaluates the translational maturity of AI-ECG across arrhythmias, acute myocardial infarction, heart failure, valvular heart disease, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and cardiac amyloidosis. PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Web of Science were searched from January 1, 2022, through July 10, 2026, with earlier landmark studies added by backward citation tracking. Seventy-seven publications informed the review. Evidence was appraised using five clinically oriented criteria: intended use, reference-standard reliability, external validation and transportability, clinical actionability, and effects on workflow or patient outcomes. AI-ECG has progressed furthest in ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction triage and reduced-left-ventricular-ejection-fraction screening, where prospective or randomized studies have demonstrated workflow or diagnostic-yield benefits, whereas acute myocardial infarction rule-out has reached prospective multicenter diagnostic validation. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy screening has also advanced through international validation and prospective implementation. By contrast, occlusion myocardial infarction detection, prediction of occult or future atrial fibrillation, valvular heart disease, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, long-term heart-failure prediction, and cardiac amyloidosis remain primarily validation-stage or risk-enrichment applications. Across domains, broader adoption is constrained by label quality, calibration, transportability, operating-threshold selection, and limited patient-outcome evidence. AI-ECG is therefore best positioned as clinician-supervised decision support linked to explicit downstream testing and care pathways.
zh_abstract: 心电图是一种广泛可用且低成本的心血管检查，人工智能赋能心电图（AI-ECG）能够识别常规解读之外的潜在电学表型。然而，高回顾性判别能力并不一定转化为临床可靠或可操作的获益。本批判性叙述综述评估AI-ECG在心律失常、急性心肌梗死、心力衰竭、瓣膜性心脏病、肥厚型心肌病和心脏淀粉样变性中的转化成熟度。检索PubMed、IEEE Xplore和Web of Science，时间范围为2022年1月1日至2026年7月10日，并通过后向引文追踪补充了更早的里程碑研究。77篇文献为本综述提供依据。采用五项临床导向标准评价证据：预期用途、参考标准可靠性、外部验证与可迁移性、临床可操作性，以及对工作流程或患者结局的影响。AI-ECG在ST段抬高型心肌梗死分诊和左心室射血分数降低筛查方面进展最远，前瞻性或随机研究已证明其工作流程或诊断产出获益，而急性心肌梗死排除已达到前瞻性多中心诊断验证。肥厚型心肌病筛查也通过国际验证和前瞻性实施取得进展。相比之下，闭塞性心肌梗死检测、隐匿性或未来心房颤动的预测、瓣膜性心脏病、射血分数保留的心力衰竭、长期心力衰竭预测和心脏淀粉样变性仍主要处于验证阶段或风险富集应用阶段。在各领域中，更广泛的应用受到标签质量、校准、可迁移性、操作阈值选择以及患者结局证据有限的制约。因此，AI-ECG最适合定位为临床医生监督下的决策支持，并与明确的下游检测和诊疗路径相衔接。

title: Beyond the Balance Sheet: Tangible and Intangible Return on Investment in Radiology Artificial Intelligence Adoption.
source: PubMed · Seminars in ultrasound, CT, and MR
zh_title: 放射AI采纳的投资回报：有形与无形价值
summary: 论述放射AI产品ROI评估应兼顾可计费收入等有形价值与诊断信心、人员留存等无形价值。
key_points: FDA获批放射AI产品数量超出财务评估能力
ROI框架需纳入有形与无形两类价值
供医院管理层与AI治理委员会参考
reason: 同行评审观点文章，无论证数据，按综述观点类上限判为增量档
abstract: [Seminars in ultrasound, CT, and MR] Artificial intelligence (AI) products for radiology are being cleared by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) at a pace that has outrun the field's ability to evaluate them financially. Hospital leadership, radiology directors, and other members on AI governance committees are routinely asked to justify high upfront and recurring costs using a return-on-investment (ROI) vocabulary built for capital equipment with a direct revenue line - a vocabulary that fits only a minority of the products now on the market. This paper argues that AI product ROI, when properly assessed, is not limited to departmental cash flows and must include both tangible value (billable revenue, throughput, avoided cost) and intangible value (diagnostic confidence, workforce retention, referring-physician trust, institutional reputation, and strategic optionality). This paper also reasons that the balance between tangible and intangible value is not constant across AI products or timelines. Instead, this balance shifts somewhat predictably with the underlying technology architecture and its associated use case, from narrow triage tools with fast, mostly tangible payoffs to platform and language-model products whose value is more diffuse and harder to separate from the surrounding workflow. Lastly, this paper proposes a governance framework - anchored by a proxy-measurement table that operationalizes both tangible and intangible value across eleven institutional domains - to help radiology leadership evaluate tangible and intangible ROI together at the point of purchase and track how each is expected to move across the product's operating life, ensuring deployment and renewal decisions are judged against realistic expectations for each individual AI technology for its specific use case.
zh_abstract: [Seminars in ultrasound, CT, and MR] 放射学人工智能（AI）产品正以美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的速度进入市场，这一速度已超出该领域对其进行财务评估的能力。医院领导层、放射科主任以及 AI 治理委员会的其他成员经常被要求使用为具有直接收入来源的资本设备而建立的投资回报率（ROI）术语，来证明高额前期成本和经常性成本是合理的——而这一术语只适用于当前市场上的少数产品。本文认为，AI 产品的 ROI 在得到恰当评估时，并不限于科室现金流，还必须包括有形价值（可计费收入、吞吐量、避免的成本）和无形价值（诊断信心、员工留任、转诊医生信任、机构声誉和战略选择权）。本文还论证，有形价值与无形价值之间的平衡并非在各类 AI 产品或不同时间线上恒定不变。相反，这种平衡会随底层技术架构及其相关用例而发生某种可预测的变化：从具有快速、主要是有形回报的狭窄分诊工具，到价值更为分散且更难与周围工作流程分离的平台和语言模型产品。最后，本文提出一个治理框架——以一张代理测量表为锚点，该表在十一个机构领域中将有形价值和无形价值操作化——以帮助放射科领导层在采购时点共同评估有形和无形 ROI，并跟踪二者在产品运营生命周期内预计如何变化，确保部署和续约决策是针对每种特定用例下的每一项 AI 技术、依据现实预期来评判。

title: FateDriver: Weakly supervised dual-view graph learning for transition-specific prioritization of candidate regulators in cellular reprogramming
zh_title: FateDriver：弱监督双视图图学习排序重编程调控因子
summary: 预印本提出弱监督双视图图神经网络，以已递送因子作稀疏标签，优先排序细胞重编程候选调控因子。
key_points: 联合表征单细胞转录组中的细胞与基因
在 2 个 OSKM 与 1 个 GMT 数据集评测
在 6 种方法中参考基因召回排名前二
reason: 预印本方法有基线对比，但仅计算评测、无实验验证
abstract: Cellular reprogramming supports regenerative medicine, yet the endogenous regulators of a specified source-to-target transition remain incompletely defined. Existing computational methods rank candidate regulators from network topology, trajectory dynamics, or cell-state labels, leaving unused the factors experimentally delivered to induce the transition. We present FateDriver, a weakly supervised dual-view graph neural network that jointly represents cells and genes from single-cell transcriptomes, treats the delivered factors as sparse gene-level labels, and ranks the remaining genes for a specified transition under a positive--unlabeled formulation. Across two OSKM datasets and one GMT dataset, FateDriver ranked first or second among six methods in recovering externally curated reference genes, exceeded a supervision-matched non-graph model despite weaker co-expression with the delivered factors, and achieved the highest recovery of protein targets of pluripotency-inducing chemical cocktails in both OSKM datasets. Holding either the source or the endpoint fixed yielded distinct candidate programs, including a DDX58--interferon axis associated with cells lacking endogenous pluripotency markers. Applying the same framework to candidate source--target pairs prioritized distinct candidate origins for two in vivo partially reprogrammed intestinal populations. FateDriver converts sparse experimental knowledge into transition-specific hypotheses for regulator prioritization from single-cell trajectories.
zh_abstract: 细胞重编程支持再生医学，然而特定来源向目标转变的内源性调控因子仍未完全明确。现有计算方法基于网络拓扑、轨迹动力学或细胞状态标签对候选调控因子进行排序，却未利用实验递送以诱导该转变的因素。我们提出FateDriver，一种弱监督双视图图神经网络，它联合表示单细胞转录组中的细胞和基因，将递送的因素视为稀疏的基因水平标签，并在正—未标记（positive--unlabeled）框架下为特定转变对其余基因进行排序。在两个OSKM数据集和一个GMT数据集上，FateDriver在回收外部整理的参考基因方面在六种方法中排名第一或第二，尽管与递送因素的共表达较弱，仍超过监督匹配的非图模型，并在两个OSKM数据集中对多能性诱导化学混合物蛋白靶点的回收率最高。固定来源或终点任一者会产生不同的候选程序，包括与缺乏内源性多能性标志物的细胞相关的DDX58—干扰素轴。将同一框架应用于候选来源—目标对，为两个体内部分重编程肠道群体优先排序出不同的候选起源。FateDriver将稀疏的实验知识转化为从单细胞轨迹中进行调控因子优先级排序的转变特异性假设。

title: Interpreting graph neural networks reveals microbial association patterns in inflammatory bowel diseases
zh_title: 图神经网络解读IBD肠道微生物关联模式
summary: 用个体化微生物关联网络训练可解释GNN区分IBD，并与随机森林对比。
key_points: 基于106人纵向宏基因组数据
RF预测性能高于GNN（AUPRC约0.59对0.446）
GNN预测依赖拟杆菌目共丰度模块
reason: 预印本、样本仅106人且无外部验证，但可解释性方法与基线对比清晰，属值得一看档
abstract: Traditional machine learning models trained on gut microbiome abundance profiles can distinguish individuals with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) from non-IBD individuals. However, their interpretation typically considers taxa in isolation, making it difficult to understand how associations between taxa contribute to predictions. Here, we inferred individual-specific microbial association networks from longitudinal metagenomics data of 106 individuals in HMP2/iHMP and used them to train and interpret graph neural network (GNN) models, which we compared with abundance-based models such as Random Forest (RF). Although RF achieved higher predictive performance (AUPRC ~0.59 vs 0.446), interpreting the GNNs revealed that their predictions relied on a densely connected module of co-abundant Bacteroidales species. Unlike the taxa prioritized by RF, these species were not differentially abundant between conditions. In an independent cohort, this module carried most of the predictive signal, and removing its associations reduced performance to near chance. These results show that coordinated association structure, rather than abundance shifts alone, is a feature of the IBD gut microbiome, and that interpreting GNNs can uncover such patterns that complement abundance-based analyses.
zh_abstract: 基于肠道微生物组丰度谱训练的传统机器学习模型能够区分炎症性肠病（IBD）个体与非 IBD 个体。然而，其解释通常孤立地考虑分类群，难以理解分类群之间的关联如何贡献于预测。在此，我们从 HMP2/iHMP 中 106 名个体的纵向宏基因组数据推断个体特异性微生物关联网络，并用其训练和解释图神经网络（GNN）模型，将其与随机森林（RF）等基于丰度的模型进行比较。尽管 RF 取得了更高的预测性能（AUPRC 约 0.59 对 0.446），解释 GNN 显示其预测依赖于一个由共丰度拟杆菌目（Bacteroidales）物种组成的密集连接模块。与 RF 优先考虑的分类群不同，这些物种在两种状态之间并无差异丰度。在一个独立队列中，该模块承载了大部分预测信号，移除其关联后性能降至接近随机水平。这些结果表明，协调的关联结构而非仅丰度变化是 IBD 肠道微生物组的一个特征，并且解释 GNN 能够揭示此类补充基于丰度分析的模式。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation.

summary: 系统综述纳入9项研究，评估AI在面提升手术客观疗效评估与患者感知中的应用。
key_points: 按PRISMA指南开展，纳入2020–2025年9项研究

abstract: [Aesthetic plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a tool for objective outcome assessment in facelift surgery (rhytidectomy), yet the clinical validity and limitations of these technologies remain incompletely characterized. This review evaluates the evidence on AI applications in facelift surgery, focusing on neural network based age estimation, concordance with patient perception, and large language model (LLM) supported patient counseling. A systematic review was conducted following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. Databases were searched for studies applying AI to facelift surgery with primary clinical data. Nine studies published between 2020 and 2025 met inclusion criteria. Convolutional neural networks quantified postoperative age reduction ranging from 1.7 to 5.8 years depending on surgical technique and follow-up interval. AI-derived estimates consistently underestimated patient-perceived rejuvenation by approximately 35% to 50%. Superficial musculoaponeurotic system-based techniques demonstrated greater AI-measured age reduction than skin-only procedures. LLMs achieved 85% to 88% diagnostic accuracy for patient counseling but exceeded recommended readability standards. AI enables objective quantification of facelift outcomes but demonstrates systematic discordance with patient perception. Current AI modalities should function as adjuncts to validated patient-reported outcome measures, not replacements. These preliminary findings warrant cautious interpretation given the limited and heterogeneous evidence base. Ethical concerns regarding algorithmic definitions of surgical success warrant consideration. This journal requires that authors assign a level of evidence to each article. For a full description of these Evidence-Based Medicine ratings, please refer to the Table of Contents or the online Instructions to Authors www.springer.com/00266 .
zh_abstract: [Aesthetic Plastic Surgery] 人工智能（AI）已成为面提升术（除皱术，rhytidectomy）中客观结果评估的工具，但这些技术的临床有效性和局限性仍未得到充分表征。本综述评估 AI 在面提升术中应用的证据，重点关注基于神经网络的年龄估计、与患者感知的一致性，以及大语言模型（LLM）支持的患者咨询。按照系统综述和荟萃分析首选报告条目（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses）指南开展了一项系统综述。检索数据库，纳入将 AI 应用于面提升术且具有原始临床数据的研究。2020 年至 2025 年间发表的九项研究符合纳入标准。卷积神经网络量化了术后年龄减少，范围为 1.7 至 5.8 岁，具体取决于手术技术和随访间隔。AI 得出的估计持续低估患者感知的年轻化程度约 35% 至 50%。基于表浅肌肉腱膜系统（SMAS）的技术显示出比仅皮肤手术更大的 AI 测量年龄减少。LLM 在患者咨询中达到 85% 至 88% 的诊断准确率，但超出了推荐的可读性标准。AI 能够客观量化面提升术结果，但与患者感知存在系统性不一致。当前的 AI 模式应作为经过验证的患者报告结局测量工具的辅助手段，而非替代品。鉴于证据基础有限且异质，这些初步发现需要谨慎解读。关于手术成功的算法定义的伦理担忧值得考虑。本刊要求作者为每篇文章分配证据水平。有关这些循证医学评级的完整说明，请参阅目录或在线作者须知 www.springer.com/00266。

title: Advances in artificial intelligence-driven MRI research in Alzheimer's disease.
zh_title: AI驱动MRI在阿尔茨海默病研究中的进展

key_points: 覆盖诊断、分期、预后与疗效监测
涉及深度学习与多模态数据
为综述，未报告新模型或验证

abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] Alzheimer's disease (AD), the most prevalent neurodegenerative disorder, poses substantial challenges for early diagnosis and longitudinal monitoring-two cornerstones of effective clinical management and therapeutic intervention. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), owing to its non-invasiveness and high spatial resolution, has emerged as an indispensable tool in AD research. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) techniques, has demonstrated remarkable potential for automating MRI analysis, extracting subtle imaging features, and supporting objective disease prediction. This review comprehensively summarizes the latest advances in AI-driven MRI applications for AD diagnosis, staging, prognosis, and adjuvant therapeutic monitoring. It highlights key progress in AI model development, multimodal data processing, and clinical translational value. Furthermore, current bottlenecks, including data heterogeneity, model interpretability, and real-world deployment, are systematically discussed, and future directions are outlined to enhance the precision and clinical utility of AI-assisted MRI in AD. Overall, AI-MRI has evolved from laboratory validation toward early clinical adoption, with explainability and multi-center generalizability identified as critical priorities in the next research phase.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是最常见的神经退行性疾病，对早期诊断和纵向监测构成重大挑战——这两者是有效临床管理和治疗干预的基石。磁共振成像（MRI）因其无创性和高空间分辨率，已成为AD研究中不可或缺的工具。近年来，人工智能（AI），尤其是深度学习（DL）和机器学习（ML）技术，在自动化MRI分析、提取细微影像特征以及支持客观疾病预测方面展现出显著潜力。本综述全面总结了AI驱动的MRI应用在AD诊断、分期、预后和辅助治疗监测方面的最新进展。它重点介绍了AI模型开发、多模态数据处理和临床转化价值方面的关键进展。此外，系统讨论了当前瓶颈，包括数据异质性、模型可解释性和真实世界部署，并概述了未来方向，以提高AI辅助MRI在AD中的精确性和临床实用性。总体而言，AI-MRI已从实验室验证走向早期临床采用，可解释性和多中心泛化性被确定为下一研究阶段的关键优先事项。

title: MATS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Controllable and Reflective Tumor Synthesis
zh_title: MATS：可控可反思的多智能体肿瘤合成框架
summary: 预印本提出多智能体框架，实现文本可控、跨器官的肿瘤图像合成并闭环校验生成质量。
key_points: 刻画目标疾病的形态学属性分布
两阶段扩散生成肿瘤掩膜与纹理
闭环反思机制校验合成质量
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，缺少外部验证与临床结局
abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.
zh_abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真的肿瘤有助于解决临床AI的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有的基于扩散的方法缺乏细粒度属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态模式代表性不足的认知。我们提出MATS，一个用于文本可控、跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS首先在涵盖肿瘤几何形状和外观的细粒度属性空间上刻画其形态分布，并构建生成计划：扩增代表性不足的亚型，同时保持常见亚型占主导。然后，它定位目标器官，提出解剖学上有效的放置位置，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩膜和渲染纹理，二者分别以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在整个合成过程的三个检查点验证属性对齐，并在检测到错位时提供针对性反馈以指导重新生成。仅在单源胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤数据集上训练，MATS在域内以及跨LiTS、KiTS和MSD-Pancreas基准上均持续改善下游分割，而大多数先前的生成式增强方法低于仅用真实数据训练。

title: Segment Anything Pancreas: A Unified MRI Segmentation Model for Pancreatic Cancer Radiotherapy
zh_title: Segment Anything Pancreas：胰腺癌放疗统一MRI分割模型
summary: 预印本提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，用共享MedNeXt编码器多任务头统一分割胰腺、亚区、肿瘤与危及器官。
key_points: 共享编码器加三输出头实现多任务分割
标注感知损失支持部分标注数据训练
在142例PANTHER患者上三折交叉验证
reason: 方法有新意的预印本，仅内部交叉验证、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Limited tumor annotations and incomplete labels across MRI datasets hinder unified segmentation of pancreatic tumors and organs at risk (OARs) for MRI-guided radiotherapy. Purpose: We propose Pancreas-MedNeXt, a unified model that segments the whole pancreas, its subregions, tumors, and surrounding OARs from one MRI volume. Methods: The model uses a shared MedNeXt encoder-decoder with supervised whole-pancreas and subregion pretraining, followed by multitask fine-tuning. Three output heads predict the pancreatic subregions, tumor, and OARs (stomach, duodenum, kidneys). An annotation-aware loss allows training on partially labeled data without treating unannotated structures as background. Pancreas and tumor were evaluated by three-fold cross-validation on 142 PANTHER patients (92 diagnostic, 50 MR-Linac), subregions and OARs on Cyst-X and AMOS test sets, and pancreas and OARs on 33 external T1-weighted TotalSegmentator scans. Comparisons with nnU-Net, MedNeXt, VISTA3D, and Swin UNETR used the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) with paired bootstrap 95% CIs. Results: Pancreas-MedNeXt achieved the highest mean pancreas and tumor DSC on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI. Tumor DSC was 58.41% and 42.55%, exceeding task-specific MedNeXt by 4.94 (95% CI: 0.28-9.45) and 5.89 (95% CI: 2.37-9.72) percentage points, respectively. Whole-pancreas DSC was 85.73% and 70.66%. Pretraining improved head, body, and tail DSC by 2.01, 3.00, and 3.78 percentage points over training from scratch. It also achieved the highest DSC for the pancreas, duodenum, and right kidney on AMOS, and for all five organs on external MRI, exceeding the next-best method by 4.92-8.85 percentage points.Conclusion: A single Pancreas-MedNeXt model segments tumors, pancreatic subregions, and OARs on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI, which could streamline contouring for pancreatic cancer radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: 【背景】MRI数据集中肿瘤标注有限且标签不完整，阻碍了MRI引导放疗中胰腺肿瘤和危及器官（OAR）的统一分割。【目的】我们提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，一种统一模型，可从单个MRI体积中分割全胰腺、其亚区、肿瘤及周围OAR。【方法】该模型使用共享的MedNeXt编码器-解码器，先进行有监督的全胰腺和亚区预训练，随后进行多任务微调。三个输出头分别预测胰腺亚区、肿瘤和OAR（胃、十二指肠、肾脏）。标注感知损失允许在部分标注数据上训练，而不会将未标注结构视为背景。胰腺和肿瘤在142例PANTHER患者（92例诊断性MRI，50例MR-Linac）上通过三折交叉验证评估，亚区和OAR在Cyst-X和AMOS测试集上评估，胰腺和OAR在33例外部T1加权TotalSegmentator扫描上评估。与nnU-Net、MedNeXt、VISTA3D和Swin UNETR的比较使用Dice相似系数（DSC）及配对bootstrap 95% CI。【结果】Pancreas-MedNeXt在诊断性和MR-Linac MRI上取得最高的平均胰腺和肿瘤DSC。肿瘤DSC分别为58.41%和42.55%，分别超过任务特异性MedNeXt 4.94（95% CI：0.28-9.45）和5.89（95% CI：2.37-9.72）个百分点。全胰腺DSC分别为85.73%和70.66%。与从头训练相比，预训练使头、体、尾DSC分别提高2.01、3.00和3.78个百分点。它还在AMOS上取得胰腺、十二指肠和右肾的最高DSC，并在外部MRI上取得全部五个器官的最高DSC，超过次优方法4.92-8.85个百分点。【结论】单一Pancreas-MedNeXt模型可在诊断性和MR-Linac MRI上分割肿瘤、胰腺亚区和OAR，有望简化胰腺癌放疗的勾画流程。

title: CAMEL: Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning for Ultra-Lightweight Retinal Foundation Models
zh_title: CAMEL：超轻量视网膜基础模型的跨架构掩码学习
summary: 预印本提出跨架构掩码嵌入学习方法CAMEL，旨在降低视网膜基础模型的计算开销以适配临床硬件约束。
key_points: 针对RETFound等模型算力开销过大的问题
采用跨架构掩码嵌入学习构建轻量模型
面向硬件受限场景的筛查部署需求
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Recent progress in deep learning has substantially advanced automated grading of ophthalmologic pathologies, supported by large annotated datasets and improved representation learning. However, a significant gap remains between state-of-the-art performance and clinical scalability. In particular, foundation models have reshaped image-based medical screening and diagnosis. These large-scale architectures trained on extensive datasets learn rich, generalizable feature representations that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks. In ophthalmology, RETFound, one of the most relevant foundation models for retinal images, performs strongly across classification, segmentation, and risk prediction tasks. Despite their effectiveness, foundation models are often computationally prohibitive, hindering their deployment in real-world clinical environments where hardware constraints and latency are critical. To bridge this gap, we introduce CAMEL (Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning), a novel cross-architecture distillation framework that uses an asymmetric masking strategy during embedding learning to effectively transfer knowledge from massive teacher foundation models to compact, lightweight student models. Our experimental evaluation across four datasets shows that CAMEL preserves accuracy while drastically reducing computational complexity, enabling lightweight yet highly accurate models suitable for resource-limited clinical settings.
zh_abstract: 深度学习的最新进展在大型标注数据集和改进的表征学习支持下，显著推进了眼科病变的自动分级。然而，最先进性能与临床可扩展性之间仍存在显著差距。特别是，基础模型重塑了基于图像的医学筛查和诊断。这些在广泛数据集上训练的大规模架构学习到丰富、可泛化的特征表征，可适配广泛的下游任务。在眼科中，RETFound 是最相关的视网膜图像基础模型之一，在分类、分割和风险预测任务中表现强劲。尽管有效，基础模型通常计算成本过高，阻碍了其在硬件约束和延迟至关重要的真实临床环境中的部署。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 CAMEL（Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning），一种新颖的跨架构蒸馏框架，在嵌入学习期间使用非对称掩蔽策略，有效将知识从大型教师基础模型迁移到紧凑、轻量的学生模型。我们在四个数据集上的实验评估表明，CAMEL 在保持准确性的同时大幅降低计算复杂度，使轻量且高度准确的模型适用于资源有限的临床环境。

title: Sparse Autoencoders for Expert-Assisted Interpretation of Histopathology Foundation Model Embeddings
zh_title: 稀疏自编码器解析病理基础模型嵌入
summary: 用稀疏自编码器将病理基础模型嵌入分解为稀疏潜在特征，供病理专家辅助解读。
key_points: 在NCT-CRC嵌入上训练两种SAE变体
以CONCH为主，UNI2-h作稳健性验证
从重建保真度、稀疏性与标签富集等评估
reason: 有新意的可解释性预印本，对比有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Histopathology foundation models learn rich embedding representations, but their internal structure remains difficult to inspect. Concept-level interpretability is particularly relevant in computational pathology because pathologists reason through recurring morphological and tissue-level patterns, including tissue architecture, cellular morphology, staining variation, and artifacts. In this work, we investigate whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can decompose embeddings from histopathology foundation models into sparse latent features suitable for expert-assisted interpretation. We train vanilla and Batch-TopK SAE variants on NCT-CRC embeddings, using CONCH as the primary foundation model and UNI2-h as an additional robustness evaluation, and characterize the resulting latent features through reconstruction fidelity, sparsity, coherence, label enrichment, and downstream class-signal preservation. The learned sparse representations preserve most downstream tissue-class information, and their latent features retrieve more coherent and label-concentrated patch groups than raw embedding dimensions or PCA components. Discussions with pathology experts further motivated a WSI-level latent visualization workflow that places feature activations into larger tissue context. Overall, the additional UNI2-h evaluation suggests that the observed behavior is not specific to CONCH, supporting the use of sparse autoencoders for expert-assisted analysis of histopathology foundation-model embeddings, while emphasizing that latent features should be treated as candidate concepts requiring pathological assessment rather than automatically validated histopathological concepts.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学基础模型学习丰富的嵌入表示，但其内部结构仍难以检查。概念层面的可解释性在计算病理学中尤其相关，因为病理学家通过反复出现的形态学和组织层面模式进行推理，包括组织结构、细胞形态、染色变异和伪影。在这项工作中，我们研究稀疏自编码器（SAEs）能否将组织病理学基础模型的嵌入分解为适合专家辅助解释的稀疏潜在特征。我们在 NCT-CRC 嵌入上训练普通（vanilla）和 Batch-TopK SAE 变体，以 CONCH 作为主要基础模型，并以 UNI2-h 作为额外的稳健性评估，通过重建保真度、稀疏性、连贯性、标签富集以及下游类别信号保留来表征所得潜在特征。学到的稀疏表示保留了大多数下游组织类别信息，并且其潜在特征所检索到的图像块组比原始嵌入维度或 PCA 成分更连贯且标签更集中。与病理学专家的讨论进一步促成了一个 WSI 层面的潜在可视化工作流程，该流程将特征激活置于更大的组织背景中。总体而言，额外的 UNI2-h 评估表明所观察到的行为并非 CONCH 所特有，支持使用稀疏自编码器对组织病理学基础模型嵌入进行专家辅助分析，同时强调潜在特征应被视为需要病理学评估的候选概念，而不是自动验证的组织病理学概念。

title: PathoJev: Efficient Pathology Decisions from Shared Visual Context
zh_title: PathoJev：共享视觉上下文的高效病理决策模型
summary: 提出病理模型PathoJev，单次编码全切片后批量预测多个问题的答案概率，减少逐题推理延迟。
key_points: 9B与27B模型在三个全切片基准平均准确率77.2%与78.1%
分别高于SlideChat 5.4与6.3个百分点
复用混合骨干网络循环状态降低计算量
reason: 预印本新模型，有基准对比但未见外部验证或开源，属值得一看档
abstract: Pathology workflows require multiple visual judgments about the same slide, from identifying tumor type to assessing grade and invasion. Generating and parsing a separate textual response for each structured question adds latency between visual evidence and usable decisions. Building on the System One paradigm, we introduce PathoJev, a pathology model that directly predicts answer probabilities for whole-slide and region-level assessment. PathoJev encodes each slide once and evaluates independent question suffixes in batches over the shared visual context. Reusing the hybrid backbone's recurrent states further limits the computation that grows with slide-context length for each additional question. Across three whole-slide benchmarks, the 9B and 27B models achieve mean accuracies of 77.2% and 78.1%, exceeding SlideChat by 5.4 and 6.3 percentage points. Both scales also maintain competitive accuracy on five ROI benchmarks. On WSI-Bench, the 9B model runs 9.1x faster than SlideChat. Shared context accelerates eight-question workloads by 6.9x and 5.9x over separate prefix encoding, rising to 11.2x and 8.9x for 64 questions. These results provide a reusable probabilistic interface for combining multiple visual judgments in whole-slide and local tissue assessment. Code: https://github.com/ChyaZhang/PathoJev.
zh_abstract: 病理工作流程需要对同一张切片作出多项视觉判断，从识别肿瘤类型到评估分级和浸润。为每个结构化问题分别生成并解析一个文本回答，会增加视觉证据与可用决策之间的延迟。基于System One范式，我们提出PathoJev，一种直接预测全切片和区域级评估答案概率的病理模型。PathoJev对每张切片仅编码一次，并在共享视觉上下文上批量评估独立的问题后缀。复用混合骨干网络的循环状态，进一步限制了每增加一个问题时随切片上下文长度增长的计算量。在三个全切片基准上，9B和27B模型分别达到77.2%和78.1%的平均准确率，比SlideChat分别高出5.4和6.3个百分点。两种规模模型在五个ROI基准上也保持有竞争力的准确率。在WSI-Bench上，9B模型运行速度比SlideChat快9.1倍。共享上下文使八问题工作负载相较于单独前缀编码分别加速6.9倍和5.9倍，在64个问题时提升至11.2倍和8.9倍。这些结果为在全切片和局部组织评估中组合多项视觉判断提供了可复用的概率接口。代码：https://github.com/ChyaZhang/PathoJev。

title: Single-Annotation, Multi-Hypothesis Segmentation with Semantic-Spatial Residual Banks
zh_title: 单标注多假设分割与语义-空间残差库
summary: 提出语义-空间残差库方法，在每图仅一个标注的训练条件下生成覆盖多名标注者差异的分割假设集合。
key_points: 研究单标注训练、多假设输出的分割设定
冻结语义库并学习图像残差生成各假设
五个医学任务上覆盖度优于Probabilistic U-Net
reason: 有基线对比的预印本方法，医学任务验证但缺外部与临床验证
abstract: Multi-rater segmentation datasets show that a single image can admit several valid masks, yet most training sets expose only one annotation per image. We study single-annotation multi-hypothesis segmentation: each training image exposes one fixed mask, while the model must return a finite bank that covers held-out human annotations at test time. Our experiments reveal a representation tradeoff. Banks learned directly from images recover variations in local boundaries and extent but lose structural hypotheses, whereas frozen semantic features preserve structural grouping but underrepresent spatial variation. We introduce the Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank (SSRB), which freezes a semantic bank trained with balanced assignments and learns a residual from the image for each hypothesis. Across five medical endpoints, SSRB improves coverage of held-out masks at $K=8$ over a Probabilistic U-Net under the same one-mask constraint. On LIDC and LIDC-hard, it also produces substantially more distinct useful masks. On BSDS, it preserves the semantic bank's performance in grouping regions. Its advantage grows as more masks are returned, showing that residuals learned for corresponding heads improve coverage of local annotation variation while preserving how regions are grouped.
zh_abstract: 多阅片者分割数据集显示，单张图像可以对应多个有效掩膜，但大多数训练集每张图像只提供一个标注。我们研究单标注多假设分割：每张训练图像只提供一个固定掩膜，而模型在测试时必须返回一个有限集合，以覆盖留出的人类标注。我们的实验揭示了一种表示权衡。直接从图像学习得到的集合能够恢复局部边界和范围的变化，但会丢失结构性假设；而冻结的语义特征保留了结构分组，但对空间变化的表示不足。我们提出语义-空间残差集合（Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank，SSRB），它冻结通过平衡分配训练得到的语义集合，并针对每个假设从图像学习残差。在五个医学终点上，SSRB在相同单掩膜约束下，于$K=8$时相比Probabilistic U-Net提高了对留出掩膜的覆盖。在LIDC和LIDC-hard上，它还能产生显著更多不同的有用掩膜。在BSDS上，它保留了语义集合在区域分组方面的性能。随着返回更多掩膜，其优势增大，表明为对应头学习的残差提高了对局部标注变化的覆盖，同时保留了区域分组方式。

title: LAPIS: Clinically Constrained Patient-Identity Residual Learning for Chest X-Ray Anonymization
zh_title: LAPIS：胸片患者身份残差学习的匿名化方法
summary: 提出LAPIS方法，将胸片中的患者身份信息压缩至可替换残差通道以实现匿名化。
key_points: 用半正交基定义身份残差通道并加以替换
以空间对抗训练抑制互补部分的身份泄漏
在ChestX-ray14上按患者划分评估重识别攻击
属arXiv预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 隐私保护新方法且有公开数据集评估，但为预印本、无外部临床验证。
abstract: Biometric information in chest radiographs limits their release for research, as patients can be re-identified. We propose LAPIS, which jointly adapts a spatial chest-radiograph latent space so that patient-discriminative information concentrates in a compact, replaceable channel residual while most clinically relevant content stays in the complement. The residual is defined by an exactly semi-orthogonal basis, a spatial adversary suppresses identity leakage from the complement, and replacement-aware training teaches the decoder cross-patient residual swaps under output identity, clinical and realism constraints, so that replacing the residual yields a valid image. At release, the residual is replaced by a mixture of donor residuals. On patient-disjoint model, release and test sets from ChestX-ray14, we evaluate attackers adapted to the anonymized setting, a structural source-retrieval attack, and pathology classifiers trained on released images and tested on real ones. LAPIS reduces worst-case cross-study linkability from 0.961 to 0.791 AUC at a macro AUROC cost of 0.012 relative to reconstruction; a deformation-based baseline, however, remains better at structural source retrieval.
zh_abstract: 胸部 X 线片中的生物识别信息限制了其用于研究的发布，因为患者可能被重新识别。我们提出 LAPIS，它联合调整空间胸部 X 线片潜在空间，使患者判别性信息集中在一个紧凑、可替换的通道残差中，而大多数临床相关内容保留在互补部分。该残差由精确半正交基定义，空间对抗器抑制来自互补部分的身份泄漏，替换感知训练在输出身份、临床和真实性约束下教会解码器进行跨患者残差交换，从而使替换残差后生成有效图像。在发布时，残差由供体残差的混合替换。在来自 ChestX-ray14 的患者不相交模型集、发布集和测试集上，我们评估了适应匿名化设置的攻击者、一种结构性来源检索攻击，以及在发布图像上训练并在真实图像上测试的病理分类器。LAPIS 将最坏情况下的跨研究可链接性从 0.961 AUC 降低到 0.791 AUC，相对于重建而言宏观 AUROC 代价为 0.012；然而，基于变形的基线在结构性来源检索方面仍然更好。

title: Zonal-Aware Prostate Cancer Detection and Classification via Hadamard-Fused Mamba-UNet
zh_title: ZH-Mamba：分区感知的前列腺癌MRI检测框架
summary: 预印本提出ZH-Mamba多阶段框架，用Hadamard融合的Mamba-UNet做前列腺分区与病灶定位，再分类临床显著前列腺癌。
key_points: 双H-Mamba UNet分别完成腺体分区与病灶定位
可学习Hadamard变换融合分区与病灶特征，不增算力
摘要未报告外部验证或前瞻性评估
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未体现外部验证与公开代码，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) detection from prostate MRI requires a detailed understanding of the prostate anatomical context. Deep learning approaches have achieved promising results in zonal and lesion segmentation; however, the joint analysis of prostate zonal anatomy and lesion morphology in a unified framework remains relatively underexplored. In this work, we propose ZH-Mamba, a multi-stage zonal-aware csPCa detection framework consisting of two H-Mamba UNets models for prostate zonal segmentation and lesion localization, followed by an anatomy-aware Convolutional Neural Network classifier for csPCa detection. The proposed model leverages a learnable Hadamard Transform-based fusion mechanism to enhance zonal and lesion feature representations without increasing computational complexity. The learned fusion patterns consistently emphasize prostate regions, suggesting that the proposed fusion captures anatomically relevant feature representations. We demonstrate a strong zonal segmentation performance on the PI-CAI dataset, reaching Dice scores of $\textbf{0.95}$, $\textbf{0.85}$, and $\textbf{0.95}$ for whole gland (WG), peripheral zone (PZ), and transition zone (TZ), respectively, providing robust anatomical priors for downstream csPCa detection. Experimental results on an independent internal dataset confirm the generalization capability of the proposed zonal segmentation model. For lesion localization, the H-Mamba UNet achieves a competitive Dice score of $\textbf{0.70}$. Integrating the zonal masks and lesion localization, the proposed ZH-Mamba framework achieves an AUC of $\textbf{0.86}$, Average Precision ($\mathrm{AP}_{\mathrm{Patient}}$) of $\textbf{0.72}$, and F1 score of $\textbf{0.76}$, demonstrating the effectiveness of zonal-aware csPCa detection.
zh_abstract: 从前列腺MRI中准确检测临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）需要对前列腺解剖背景有详细理解。深度学习方法在分区和病灶分割方面已取得有希望的结果；然而，在统一框架中联合分析前列腺分区解剖和病灶形态仍相对未被充分探索。在本工作中，我们提出ZH-Mamba，一个多阶段分区感知csPCa检测框架，由两个用于前列腺分区分割和病灶定位的H-Mamba UNets模型，以及随后用于csPCa检测的解剖感知卷积神经网络分类器组成。所提出的模型利用基于Hadamard变换的可学习融合机制来增强分区和病灶特征表示，而不增加计算复杂度。学习到的融合模式一致地强调前列腺区域，提示所提出的融合捕获了解剖相关的特征表示。我们在PI-CAI数据集上展示了很强的分区分割性能，全腺体（WG）、外周带（PZ）和移行带（TZ）的Dice分数分别达到0.95、0.85和0.95，为下游csPCa检测提供了稳健的解剖先验。在独立内部数据集上的实验结果证实了所提出的分区分割模型的泛化能力。对于病灶定位，H-Mamba UNet达到具有竞争力的Dice分数0.70。整合分区掩膜和病灶定位，所提出的ZH-Mamba框架达到AUC 0.86、平均精度（AP_Patient）0.72和F1分数0.76，证明了分区感知csPCa检测的有效性。

title: CS-LDM: Clinically Guided Structure-Aware Latent Diffusion for Knee Radiographic Forecasting
zh_title: CS-LDM：临床引导的结构感知潜在扩散预测膝关节影像
summary: 预印本提出CS-LDM，以当前X光片与KL分级为条件，用结构感知潜在扩散模型预测患者未来膝关节影像。
key_points: 临床引导、结构感知的潜在扩散框架
采用LoRA适配与当前KL分级条件化
冻结教师模型诊断蒸馏，强调形态学可靠
reason: 有新意的生成方法预印本，未见外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a leading cause of physical disability and currently has no curative clinical treatment. Early diagnosis and accurate prognosis are therefore vital for managing its progression. Existing methods mainly predict future severity grades and provide limited visual explanation of structural change. Recent generation-guided approaches synthesize follow-up radiographs for progression assessment, but generated images are often judged by predictive accuracy or image realism, so they may satisfy a grading model while remaining morphologically unreliable. We therefore propose CS-LDM, a clinically guided, structure-aware latent diffusion framework that forecasts patient-specific future knee radiographs from the current X-ray and clinically available current KL grade, using LoRA adaptation, current-grade conditioning, and frozen-teacher diagnostic distillation. Experiments on the public Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) dataset show that CS-LDM improves future severity-grade consistency while maintaining competitive image fidelity. Further ordinal, OARSI, ROI-level, and stable/progressed analyses show that radiographic forecasting should be evaluated by balancing diagnostic consistency, anatomical plausibility, and structural preservation.
zh_abstract: 膝骨关节炎（KOA）是身体残疾的主要原因，目前尚无治愈性临床治疗。因此，早期诊断和准确预后对于管理其进展至关重要。现有方法主要预测未来严重程度分级，并对结构变化提供有限的视觉解释。近期生成引导方法合成随访X线片用于进展评估，但生成图像通常通过预测准确性或图像真实性来评判，因此它们可能满足分级模型却在形态学上仍不可靠。因此，我们提出 CS-LDM，一种临床引导、结构感知的潜在扩散框架，利用 LoRA 适配、当前分级条件化和冻结教师诊断蒸馏，从当前X线片和临床可用的当前 KL 分级预测患者特异性的未来膝关节X线片。在公开的骨关节炎倡议（OAI）数据集上的实验表明，CS-LDM 提高了未来严重程度分级一致性，同时保持有竞争力的图像保真度。进一步的序数、OARSI、ROI 层面以及稳定/进展分析表明，影像学预测应通过平衡诊断一致性、解剖合理性和结构保留来评估。

title: DiffUltra: Task-Guided Pathology Synthesis for Large-Scale Real-World Lung Ultrasound Data
zh_title: DiffUltra：面向真实世界肺超声数据的任务引导病理合成
summary: 预印本提出DiffUltra，按任务引导的潜在扩散流程生成肺超声病理图像，并用真实数据训练的过滤器筛选。
key_points: 按无回声、低回声、高回声分解病灶结构
两种策略将病灶插入或替换至背景
仅用真实数据训练过滤器筛选合成图像
reason: 针对超声数据稀缺的新颖合成方法预印本，尚无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Despite their scale, large medical imaging datasets may underrepresent clinically relevant pathological presentations. Synthetic data can expand coverage, but findings must remain compatible with surrounding anatomy. This is challenging in ultrasound, where findings resemble surrounding tissue and must be positioned relative to anatomical landmarks. We propose DiffUltra, a task-guided latent diffusion pipeline that models pathological structure and spatial context, and screens synthetic images for downstream utility. DiffUltra conditions generation on structural masks decomposing findings into anechoic, hypoechoic, and hyperechoic subregions. Two placement strategies insert findings into pathology-absent backgrounds or replace existing findings with structurally matched pathology from other patients. A filter trained exclusively on real data retains images whose predictions agree spatially with target boxes. We evaluate DiffUltra for lung ultrasound detection of pleural effusion and consolidation, using over 700,000 expert-annotated frames from 598 patients at 12 sites. Averaged across three real-data scales, synthetic insertion significantly improved video-level AUROC for both pleural effusion (p = 0.017) and consolidation (p < 0.01). For pleural effusion, frame-level average precision improved by 4.5 percentage points on average and by 6.1 points using only 10% of real data (p < 0.01 for both). Synthetic insertion also yielded larger average precision gains than an existing diffusion-based lesion-insertion method at every scale. At full scale, targeted synthesis improved AUROC for both pathologies by 1.1-3.9 points in an underrepresented anatomical zone and on a held-out acquisition system. These results suggest that anatomically constrained, task-guided synthesis can help address coverage gaps in ultrasound training data.
zh_abstract: 尽管规模庞大，大型医学影像数据集可能对临床相关病理表现的代表性不足。合成数据可以扩大覆盖范围，但发现必须与周围解剖结构保持相容。这在超声中具有挑战性，因为发现与周围组织相似，并且必须相对于解剖标志进行定位。我们提出 DiffUltra，一种任务引导的潜在扩散流程，对病理结构和空间上下文建模，并筛选合成图像以供下游使用。DiffUltra 以结构掩码为生成条件，将发现分解为无回声、低回声和高回声子区域。两种放置策略将发现插入无病变背景，或用其他患者结构匹配的病变替换现有发现。一个仅在真实数据上训练的滤波器保留预测在空间上与目标框一致的图像。我们评估 DiffUltra 用于胸腔积液和肺实变的肺部超声检测，使用来自12个中心598例患者的超过700,000帧专家标注图像。在三个真实数据规模上平均，合成插入显著提高了胸腔积液（p = 0.017）和肺实变（p < 0.01）的视频级 AUROC。对于胸腔积液，帧级平均精度平均提高4.5个百分点，而仅使用10%真实数据时提高6.1个百分点（两者 p < 0.01）。在每个规模上，合成插入也比现有的基于扩散的病灶插入方法产生更大的平均精度增益。在全规模下，靶向合成在代表性不足的解剖区域和留出采集系统上将两种病变的 AUROC 提高了1.1-3.9个百分点。这些结果表明，解剖约束的任务引导合成有助于解决超声训练数据中的覆盖缺口。

title: Report-Derived Labels, an Image Teacher and the Gap to Expert Labels in Knee MRI: An Analysis of One Entry to the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection Challenge
zh_title: 膝MRI中报告标签与图像教师模型对比专家标签
summary: 在RSNA 2026膝部异常检测挑战中，比较报告文本标签与公共图像模型预测相对专家标签的一致性。
key_points: 4407例训练研究中仅58例有专家标注
报告标签与图像模型的宏AUC为0.892与0.896
两者在不同病变上各有优势
reason: 预印本方法学分析，有基线对比但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: In the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection challenge, 58 of 4,407 training studies have expert labels for 12 findings, and the rest have only a radiology report. We compare training targets built from a language-model reading of the reports and from a public image model against two references: the expert labels and the 39,248 study-finding cells that the reports state as present or absent. The report labels and the out-of-fold predictions of the image model reach similar agreement with the expert labels (macro AUC 0.892 and 0.896) but fail on different findings. The report is better for ligament tears and patellofemoral osteoarthritis, which it never calls present when the experts do not; the image model is better for effusion, Baker's cyst, contusion, and synovitis, where the reports call the finding absent, leave it out, or call it present more often than the experts. Their equal mixture reaches 0.927 (gain over the report labels 0.035, 95% interval 0.019 to 0.052), also after removing the studies whose knee side was handled inconsistently. We did not observe a model-level gain from this better target: a 2.5D ResNet50 trained on the report labels alone scored 0.877 on the private leaderboard, after the deadline, against 0.872 for the same model trained on the mixture, and the out-of-fold advantage of the mixture is confounded by a change of code and by possible leakage through the image model's folds. A scanner prevalence prior raised agreement with the reports but not with the experts, so a report-derived reference can reward reporting habits. A rank correction for co-occurring findings gave small out-of-fold gains and no visible leaderboard effect. Our entry, a forked public ensemble with that correction, was displayed at rank 582 of 6,299 on the private leaderboard (0.943, a score shared by 287 teams). All results are exploratory; none of the models is meant for clinical use.
zh_abstract: 在 RSNA 2026 膝关节异常检测挑战赛中，4,407 项训练研究中有 58 项具有针对 12 种发现的专家标签，其余研究仅有放射学报告。我们比较了由语言模型读取报告构建的训练目标以及由公开图像模型构建的训练目标，并以两个参照为对照：专家标签，以及报告中声明为存在或不存在的 39,248 个研究-发现单元格。报告标签与图像模型的折外预测与专家标签达到相似的一致性（宏观 AUC 分别为 0.892 和 0.896），但在不同发现上失败。报告在韧带撕裂和髌股骨关节炎上更好，因为在专家不判定为存在时，它从不将其判为存在；图像模型在积液、Baker 囊肿、挫伤和滑膜炎上更好，而在这些发现上，报告比专家更常将其判为不存在、遗漏不写，或判为存在。二者的等权混合达到 0.927（较报告标签提升 0.035，95% 区间 0.019 至 0.052），在剔除膝关节侧别处理不一致的研究后也是如此。我们没有观察到这一更好的目标带来模型层面的增益：仅用报告标签训练的 2.5D ResNet50 在截止日期后于私有排行榜上得分为 0.877，而同一模型用混合目标训练得分为 0.872；并且混合目标的折外优势受到代码变更以及可能通过图像模型折次产生的泄漏所混杂。扫描仪患病率先验提高了与报告的一致性，但没有提高与专家标签的一致性，因此由报告衍生的参照可能会奖励报告习惯。针对共现发现的排名校正带来了小幅折外增益，且未观察到明显的排行榜效应。我们的参赛方案是一个带有该校正的分叉公共集成，在私有排行榜上显示为 6,299 支队伍中的第 582 名（0.943，该分数由 287 支队伍共享）。所有结果均为探索性；没有任何模型旨在用于临床。

title: Cross-Device Transfer of a Hospital-Trained Fetal Head Circumference Model to a Low-Cost Handheld Ultrasound Probe
zh_title: 医院训练胎儿头围模型迁移至低成本手持超声探头
summary: 将HC18训练的胎儿头围分割模型直接用于低成本手持探头图像，量化精度下降及预处理影响。
key_points: 域内误差2.34mm，手持图像升至16.12mm
预处理方式差异可解释约三分之一性能差距
18例患者，与同次医院扫描对照
reason: 预印本跨设备迁移实证，样本小但问题具体，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated fetal head circumference (HC) measurement reaches near-expert accuracy on the HC18 benchmark, but published models are trained and evaluated on hospital-grade equipment. We quantify what happens when such a model is carried to a low-cost handheld probe. A lightweight segmentation network (CSM, 0.13M parameters) was trained on HC18 across five independent runs and applied without modification to images from a $1,350 handheld probe (SonoQue C3), acquired at the same visit as the reference hospital scan in 18 patients. In-domain accuracy was 2.34 +/- 0.43 mm; on handheld images the same model gave 16.12 mm against the hospital record, a 6.9-fold degradation. Input preprocessing, a choice rarely reported, accounted for about a third of that gap: direct resizing gave 49.45 mm against 16.12 mm for an aspect-preserving pipeline. A leave-one-out data-efficiency curve showed that fine-tuning on two images significantly worsened accuracy, and that from four images upward error fell by 0.75 mm per doubling of the local dataset (p = 0.0045), although no training-set size up to 27 images significantly improved on the unmodified model. Much of the residual gap belongs to the reference rather than the model: scored against a manual tracing of the same image the model was already within 10.48 mm, and its disagreement with sonographer calipers on the same frame was a near-constant offset, negative in 10 of 10 cases. A single calibration constant estimated leave-one-out reduced that disagreement from 8.12 mm to 3.49 mm, reaching the intraobserver reproducibility reported for experienced sonographers, but did not improve agreement with the hospital record. Cross-device evaluations should therefore report the input preprocessing used and characterise the precision of their reference standard.
zh_abstract: 自动胎儿头围（HC）测量在HC18基准上达到接近专家的准确率，但已发表模型是在医院级设备上训练和评估的。我们量化了将此类模型迁移到低成本手持探头时会发生什么。一个轻量级分割网络（CSM，0.13M参数）在HC18上以五次独立运行进行训练，并在不作修改的情况下应用于来自一台1,350美元手持探头（SonoQue C3）的图像；这些图像在18例患者中与参考医院扫描在同一次就诊时采集。域内准确率为2.34 +/- 0.43 mm；在手持图像上，同一模型相对于医院记录的结果为16.12 mm，出现6.9倍退化。输入预处理这一很少被报告的选项约占该差距的三分之一：直接缩放给出49.45 mm，而保持长宽比的流程为16.12 mm。留一法数据效率曲线显示，用两张图像微调会显著降低准确率；从四张图像起，局部数据集每翻倍，误差下降0.75 mm（p = 0.0045），尽管直至27张图像的训练集规模均未显著优于未修改模型。剩余差距的很大部分归因于参考标准而非模型：以同一图像的人工描记为参照评分时，模型已在10.48 mm以内，并且其与超声医师在同一帧上的卡尺测量的不一致表现为近乎恒定的偏移，10/10例均为负。通过留一法估计的单个校准常数将该不一致从8.12 mm降至3.49 mm，达到经验丰富超声医师所报告的观察者内可重复性，但并未改善与医院记录的一致性。因此，跨设备评估应报告所使用的输入预处理，并描述其参考标准的精确度。

title: TheseusSyn: Unified Medical Image Synthesis via Context-Conditioned Masked Autoregression
zh_title: TheseusSyn：上下文条件化掩码自回归医学图像合成
summary: 提出以全局表征令牌为上下文约束的多码本离散分词与掩码自回归框架，通过迭代替换内容生成医学图像。
key_points: 多码本离散分词将医学图像转为令牌序列
掩码自回归结合局部邻域与全局上下文预测
目标为数据高效学习与隐私保护建模
reason: 有新意的生成方法预印本，条目未见外部验证与开源信息
abstract: High-fidelity medical image synthesis is promising for data-efficient learning and privacy-preserving model development. However, most existing approaches rely on symbolic or label-based conditioning, which constrains generative diversity and limits case-specific contextual fidelity. Inspired by the Ship of Theseus paradox, we propose TheseusSyn, a novel context-conditioned synthesis paradigm that generates images through iterative content replacement. Our framework employs a multi-codebook discrete tokenizer to convert medical images into sequences of token indices, extracted with a global representation token that serves as a contextual constraint. A masked autoregressive generative model then iteratively masks and predicts tokens conditioned on both local neighborhoods and the global context. By progressively replacing image content until the entire token sequence is renewed, TheseusSyn produces synthetic samples that preserve anatomical coherence and semantic consistency while introducing controlled diversity. We evaluate the proposed framework on multiple datasets from MedMNIST by constructing synthetic datasets with varying masking strategies and training ResNet-18 classifiers exclusively on either real or synthetic data. Experimental results demonstrate that classifiers trained on TheseusSyn-generated images achieve competitive performance on official test sets, indicating that the synthesized data preserve diagnostically relevant features and semantic consistency. Systematic analysis of masking strategies reveals their impact on structural fidelity and downstream classification accuracy. These results suggest that context-conditioned masked autoregression provides an effective and generalizable solution for label-free medical image synthesis, offering a scalable alternative to conventional data augmentation and class-conditioned generative models in medical imaging applications.

abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) represents the majority of lung cancer cases and remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Early detection, accurate staging, and individualized therapy are crucial for improving patient survival. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed NSCLC care through the automated analysis of imaging, pathology, and molecular datasets. Deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated high accuracy in tumor detection, histologic classification, biomarker prediction (PD-L1, EGFR, KRAS) and prognosis assessment. Integration of the AI with whole slide imaging (WSI), computed tomography (CT), PET/CT and liquid biopsies enables non-invasive tumor characterization, early recurrence detection and prediction of treatment response. Multimodal AI approaches that combine imaging, genomic, and clinical data offer superior patient stratification and personalized treatment planning compared with traditional methods. Beyond diagnosis, AI facilitates therapeutic development through radiomics based nodule classification, multi-omics data interpretation, and drug discovery. Radiomics, in particular, extracts quantitative imaging biomarkers that capture tumor heterogeneity beyond human perception. The AI further supports clinical decision-making in surgery, radiotherapy, and systemic therapy, enhancing workflow efficiency. Despite challenges in data quality, interpretability, and clinical adoption, AI holds significant promise for advancing precision oncology and improving outcomes in NSCLC management.

abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE] Accurate preoperative templating for total knee arthroplasty (TKA) in patients with end-stage knee osteoarthritis (KOA) remains challenging, and the accuracy of conventional planning methods is variable. This preliminary, retrospective, single-center study evaluated the reliability of a robot-independent, artificial intelligence (AI)-based, three-dimensional (3D) preoperative planning system (AIKNEE) for predicting prosthesis size and component position in patients undergoing TKA for end-stage KOA. Twenty-eight knees from 24 patients with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4 KOA were included. The primary outcome was the agreement between the planned and implanted prosthesis sizes. Secondary outcomes included correction of the coronal hip-knee-ankle (HKA) angle, improvement in Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) knee scores, and early postoperative complications. The planned size matched the implanted size exactly in 53.57% of femoral components (15/28; 95% confidence interval [CI], 35.8%-70.5%) and 46.43% of tibial components (13/28; 95% CI, 29.5%-64.2%). Agreement within ±1 size was 85.71% for femoral components (24/28; 95% CI, 68.5%-94.3%) and 96.43% for tibial components (27/28; 95% CI, 82.3%-99.4%), giving an overall matching rate of 91.07% (51/56; 95% CI, 80.7%-96.1%). The postoperative HKA angle improved from 173.0° ± 3.9° to 178.2° ± 1.2° (P < 0.001), and the HSS score increased from 39.7 ± 2.2 preoperatively to 80.8 ± 1.3 at the 1-month follow-up (P < 0.001). No major early complications, including infection, dislocation, or deep venous thrombosis, were observed. Within this preliminary cohort, the AIKNEE system predicted prosthesis size with a reliability comparable to that reported for existing AI templating tools. Because the study was retrospective, single-arm, unblinded, and limited to 1 month of follow-up, these data characterize planning accuracy only and do not demonstrate clinical effectiveness; adequately powered, controlled studies with long-term follow-up are required.
