abstract: [Acta neuropathologica] Cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a cornerstone of diagnostic evaluation in infectious, autoimmune, haemorrhagic, and neoplastic disorders of the central nervous system despite advances in neuroimaging, molecular diagnostics, and digital technologies. This narrative review summarises established principles of cerebrospinal fluid cytology, highlights methodological limitations and diagnostic pitfalls, and integrates emerging developments, including automated cell counting, artificial intelligence, and telecytology. Pre-analytical factors are critical determinants of diagnostic accuracy. Delayed sample processing promotes pH-dependent autolysis and substantial cell loss, whereas rapid cytocentrifugation preserves cellular morphology and facilitates reliable assessment. Automated cell counters are increasingly implemented in routine laboratories and offer advantages in settings with limited technical staffing. However, current systems show limited precision in samples with low and slightly elevated cell counts and limited morphological evaluation. Manual chamber counting, particularly in the normal and low-cell-count range, remains the gold standard for quantitative CSF cell assessment, whereas expert microscopic examination remains the reference standard for qualitative cytomorphological assessment. Although the sensitivity of neuroimaging continues to improve, cerebrospinal fluid cytology retains a unique diagnostic role in the detection of infectious and neoplastic conditions and in the evaluation of subarachnoid haemorrhage. Cytological detection of erythrophages, siderophages, and haematoidin crystals can reveal haemorrhage and provide clues to its temporal stage. Overall, cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a valuable diagnostic tool when integrated with clinical, laboratory, microbiological, immunological, and imaging findings. Careful recognition of common pitfalls is essential. We recommend rapid cerebrospinal fluid processing, routine preparation of cytospin-based stained slides with expert microscopic review, and the implementation of automated or digital methods only within clearly validated workflows.
zh_abstract: [Acta neuropathologica] 尽管神经影像学、分子诊断和数字技术取得进展，脑脊液细胞学仍是中枢神经系统感染性、自身免疫性、出血性和肿瘤性疾病诊断评估的基石。本叙述性综述总结脑脊液细胞学的既定原则，强调方法学局限和诊断陷阱，并整合新兴进展，包括自动细胞计数、人工智能和远程细胞学。分析前因素是诊断准确性的关键决定因素。样本处理延迟会促进pH依赖性自溶和显著细胞丢失，而快速细胞离心涂片可保留细胞形态并有助于可靠评估。自动细胞计数仪正越来越多地应用于常规实验室，在技术人员有限的环境中具有优势。然而，当前系统在细胞计数低和轻度升高的样本中精度有限，且形态学评估能力有限。手工计数池计数，尤其是在正常和低细胞计数范围内，仍是脑脊液细胞定量评估的金标准；而专家显微镜检查仍是定性细胞形态学评估的参考标准。尽管神经影像学的敏感性不断提高，脑脊液细胞学在感染性和肿瘤性疾病的检测以及蛛网膜下腔出血的评估中仍具有独特的诊断作用。细胞学检测噬红细胞、含铁血黄素细胞和血褐素结晶可揭示出血并提供其时间阶段的线索。总体而言，当与临床、实验室、微生物学、免疫学和影像学发现相结合时，脑脊液细胞学仍是有价值的诊断工具。仔细识别常见陷阱至关重要。我们推荐快速处理脑脊液、常规制备细胞离心涂片染色玻片并由专家进行显微镜复核，并且仅在经过明确验证的工作流程中实施自动化或数字化方法。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA interactions (RRIs) play a vital role in cellular processes including gene regulation, RNA editing, and translational control. Aberrant RRIs are increasingly recognized as contributors to cancer initiation, progression, and metastasis. Accurate computational prediction of RRIs therefore offers significant opportunities for cancer biomarker discovery, understanding tumor biology, and therapeutic target identification. Among machine learning approaches, support vector machines (SVMs) have been applied in RRI prediction due to their robustness in handling high-dimensional, nonlinear data and relatively small training datasets. This chapter reviews SVM-based methods for RRI prediction, highlights representative tools and strategies, and discusses current challenges and relevance to cancer application. Emerging trends that integrate SVMs with deep learning and experimental data augmentation are also outlined, pointing toward pathways for clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA 相互作用（RRIs）在包括基因调控、RNA 编辑和翻译控制在内的细胞过程中发挥至关重要的作用。异常的 RRIs 越来越被认为参与癌症发生、进展和转移。因此，准确计算预测 RRIs 为癌症生物标志物发现、理解肿瘤生物学以及治疗靶点识别提供了重要机会。在机器学习方法中，支持向量机（SVMs）因其在处理高维、非线性数据和相对较小训练数据集方面的稳健性，已被应用于 RRI 预测。本章综述基于 SVM 的 RRI 预测方法，重点介绍代表性工具和策略，并讨论当前挑战及其与癌症应用的相关性。还概述了将 SVMs 与深度学习和实验数据增强相结合的新兴趋势，指出通往临床转化的路径。

abstract: Generative audio systems can produce large libraries of personalized bedtime content, but ordinary media objectives (retention, completion, and novelty) are poorly aligned with the goal of supporting a transition toward sleep. Direct evidence for narrated bedtime audio in adults is mixed, and a recent active-controlled trial did not support such audio as a standalone treatment for sleep disturbance. We translate this uncertain evidence into conservative engineering requirements and present a multilingual pipeline for generating and narrating low-arousal sleep stories. The implemented prototype separates deterministic planning from large language model generation, represents content and delivery parameters explicitly, shapes each script through a four-phase attention taper, validates structural and lexical constraints, performs a bounded error-aware retry, and quarantines unresolved outputs. Provider-agnostic text-to-speech synthesis is followed by paragraph-aware joining, two-pass loudness normalization, and a publication gate that re-measures the saved, encoded file against fixed loudness, loudness-range, and true-peak limits. The product data model records stop position, replay, early abandonment, and completion while treating these events as ambiguous behavioral proxies rather than clinical outcomes. We contribute an evidence-to-requirement mapping, a traceable guardrail architecture with explicit acceptance thresholds, technical evaluation criteria, and a prospective protocol for testing sleep-onset effects. No clinical efficacy is claimed; the system is positioned as a relaxation and attentional-support tool whose benefit and possible reliance must be evaluated empirically.
zh_abstract: 生成式音频系统可以生成大量个性化睡前内容库，但普通媒体目标（留存、完成和新颖性）与支持向睡眠过渡的目标并不一致。关于成人 narrated bedtime audio（ narrated bedtime audio）的直接证据不一，且最近一项主动对照试验不支持将此类音频作为睡眠障碍的单独治疗。我们将这一不确定证据转化为保守的工程要求，并提出一个多语言流程，用于生成和叙述低唤醒睡眠故事。已实现的原型将确定性规划与大语言模型生成分离，显式表示内容和交付参数，通过四阶段注意力递减塑造每个脚本，验证结构和词汇约束，执行有界且错误感知的重试，并隔离未解决的输出。在与提供商无关的文本转语音合成之后，进行段落感知拼接、两遍响度归一化，以及发布门控：对保存并编码的文件重新测量，以对照固定的响度、响度范围和真峰值限制。产品数据模型记录停止位置、重播、提前放弃和完成，同时将这些事件视为模糊的行为代理指标，而非临床结局。我们的贡献包括证据到要求的映射、具有明确验收阈值且可追踪的护栏架构、技术评估标准，以及用于测试入睡效应的前瞻性方案。未声称任何临床疗效；该系统被定位为一种放松和注意力支持工具，其获益和可能的依赖必须通过实证评估。
